name: Create event types and mapper utilities
description: Define calendar event types and create mapper functions to transform reminders, deals, visits into calendar events

details: Create CalendarEvent interface with id, title, type, date, time, status, entityId, entityType
Define color mapping for each event type
mapDealToEvent() - transforms Deal to CalendarEvent (uses startDate, endDate)
getAllEventsForDate(date) - queries all stores and aggregates events
getAllEventsForMonth(date) - returns all events in month range
sortEventsByTime(events) - sorts by time, then priority

validation: Event types are properly typed with TypeScript
Mappers transform all source types correctly
Event metadata includes source entity IDs for navigation
notes: Imports from stores: useRemindersStore, useVisitsStore, useDealsStore
Deal deliverables need to be accessed via deal details
Color mapping should match artifact design (primary, orange, purple, gray)
